biarritzgrandeplage.name: Grande Plage
biarritzgrandeplage.slogan: The empress's beach, still ruled by surfers and sunset walkers.
biarritzgrandeplage.line: I know of no place more charming and more magnificent than Biarritz.

biarritzrocher.name: Rocher de la Vierge
biarritzrocher.slogan: A footbridge to a Virgin standing watch over the Atlantic.
biarritzrocher.line: The iron footbridge dates from 1886-87, and the statue of the Virgin was blessed in 1865 for whalers saved in a storm.

bayonnecathedral.name: Bayonne Cathedral
bayonnecathedral.slogan: Two Gothic spires rising over the rivers Adour and Nive.
bayonnecathedral.line: Begun in the 13th century, its two spires were only finished in the 19th, and its bell Jacques is one of France's few painted bells.

espelettevillage.name: Espelette
espelettevillage.slogan: White Basque houses draped in red chilli every autumn.
espelettevillage.line: Espelette pepper won AOC status in 2000, and its festival has filled the village every October since 1968.

rhunetrain.name: La Rhune
rhunetrain.slogan: A 1924 cog train up to the Basque frontier summit.
rhunetrain.line: The Strub rack railway, opened in 1924, climbs a gradient of up to 25% on its 35-minute ride toward the 905 m summit.
